entries.summary: Design stores font_family, letter_spacing, and text_transform as allowlisted keys. compileStylesheet maps them to hardcoded font stacks and tracking values. Injection strings are dropped on normalize.
Module Design inspector adds Font, Letter spacing, and Text transform. Changes patch #cmsBuilderLiveCss without rebuilding the canvas. Copy style includes the new bags.
No schema change. Keys live in layout_json design bags and restore with the SQL dump. Public CSS stays derived at render time.
